ns2:course.label: Professional Internship
ns2:course.description: Off-campus experience in a field directly pertaining to a subject matter in natural resources and environmental sciences. Approved for letter and S/U grading. May be repeated to a maximum of 4 hours. Prerequisite: Consent of academic advisor or Department Internship Coordinator.
